messages:
maya: Quick async check — planning a small canary for the multi-region autofail toggle tonight. Goal: 5% NA traffic -> EU fallback for 30m window, validate sticky sessions and model fallback. Can we run through a lightweight checklist and who can own verification?

tom: I can own the stickiness/affinity part. Quick Q: what stickiness TTL do we want for the canary? short TTL reduces cross-region cost but may increase reconnects.

maya: thinking 30s TTL for canary, then 5m if we move to broader rollout. Keep drain_timeout 60s.

ari: Ops procedure I recommend: 1) put target hosts in drain, 2) enable flag for canary, 3) run smoke script hitting session-affine endpoints, 4) monitor traces and token latency. Commands below:
```bash
# drain node 
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/v1/nodes/drain?host=svc-infer-03" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
# smoke load (10 req/s) 
python infra/tools/smoke_infer.py --target region=eu --users 20 --duration 120
```

jordan: Make sure fallback model mapping includes quantized variant (m-open-7b-q8 -> m-open-7b-q4f if needed). If capacity hits, we don't want unquantized fallback. Also include model-version pin to avoid accidental churn.

maya: noted — add mapping in feature flag params. Proposed flag snippet: 
```yaml
flag: autoswitch.multi_region_failover
scope: canary(5%)
params:
  stickiness_ttl: 30s
  drain_timeout: 60s
  fallback_model_map: {"open-7b": "open-7b-q4f"}
  rollout_duration: 00:30:00
```

sre-oncall: Monitoring & alerts to watch: 
- PromQL: sum(rate(inference_errors_total[2m])) by (region) > 5 -> page
- 95th_p90_token_latency across eu/na divergence > 150ms -> warn on slack
- error_ratio > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback immediately
Also make sure trace sampling for canary is higher (50%) so we can triage.

tom: PR for the guardrail config is up: github.com/redwood/release/PR-589. Can reviewers please ack? It includes the stickiness change and the TTL param.

maya: I'll do verification for app-level correctness and model fallback. Who can watch infra metrics during the window?

ari: i'll monitor node drain metrics & LB rebalancing. I'll post a quick log snippet if we see >3% 504s.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle autoswitch.multi_region_failover -> ON at 1799995200 (canary:5%) by maya.

maya: starting at ~1799995200. Checklist (hand-off):
- ari: node drain & LB checks
- tom: stickiness / session bounce testing
- jordan: model fallback verification
- sre-oncall: alerts & Prometheus watch
- maya: overall go/no-go and rollback if thresholds hit
Rollback command if needed: `flagctl set autoswitch.multi_region_failover off --who=maya --reason="canary failures"`

tom: tiny note — for the session-affine endpoints we should hit sequence endpoints (chat streaming) not just classification. Streaming exposes KV cache hits which show stickiness working.

maya: good call, include streaming smoke in the script. I'll ping reviewers on PR-589 now.

deploy-bot: toggle autoswitch.multi_region_failover turned ON at 1799995203 (canary=5%).

ari: observing initial drain, LB rebalanced, no spike in 5xx in first 2m.

sre-oncall: watching Prometheus — error_ratio=0.02% (ok), p95 latency diff NA->EU = +120ms (within guardrail). No pages yet.

jordan: model fallback confirmed for 10 sample sessions — quantized variant used on fallback path.

maya: thanks team. We'll keep the canary for 30m and reconvene async at close. If anything anomalous, call the rollback command. :thumbsup:
